item.title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, to deliver $19 million for Ports-to-Plains projects
item.description: H.R. 7148, the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026, was signed into law on Tuesday, February 3. The bill delivers $19.24 million in federal funding to advance critical planning, safety and infrastructure projects across the Ports-to-Plains corridor.
